status: client proposal; server implementation and hardware acceptance pending
notes: All HTTP paths are relative to the configured HTTPS relay prefix.
TVs authenticate HTTP using Authorization: Bearer <ownershipSecret or connection credential>.
WebSocket uses the one-use ticket in its first frame, never the URL.
Poll and socket connections share generation fencing; fallback opens a new connection.
POST messages accepts one envelope; GET poll returns messages as an array.
Server deadlines and pairing timestamps use Unix milliseconds; connection serverTime calibrates TV clock offset.
Phone endpoints forward existing TV request bodies and bearers without changing authorization.
This contract must be reconciled and versioned in IPTV Manager before production use.
